[NDBG.9.3.7] **`configurationDone`.** The adapter declares
`supportsConfigurationDoneRequest` ([NDBG.9.2.1]). On `configurationDone` after a
`launch`, it must answer and then send `stopped` at the session's current
position, with reason `"entry"` when the session has not moved. Before a
`launch` it must refuse the request with an error response.
